register.labelZh: CROWD 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: crowd around 和 crowd round 可以描述人們緊緊圍在某人、某物或某件事情周圍。；當大批人一起進入店舖、車站、大堂、升降機或其他地方時,可以使用 crowd in 和 crowd into。；crowd in on 可以描述牆壁、建築物或人群令某人感到被困或不舒服。；crowd out 可以表示空間不足,令某人或某物無法留下;亦可表示激烈競爭迫使其他人離開。
register.summaryEn: Crowd around and crowd round help you describe people forming a tight group around a person, object or event. Crowd in and crowd into are useful when many people enter a shop, station, hall, lift or other place together. Crowd in on can describe walls, buildings or people making somebody feel trapped or uncomfortable. Crowd out can show that there is no longer enough room for somebody or something, or that strong competition forces others away.
